graph_discipline: Roots remain nodes; branches are edge or port labels, not graph nodes.

root_resolution.note: The basmala is part of the analysis frame and reinforces divine authority, mercy, worship, and nearness without adding roots to the supplied inventory. Three Furūq-only branches remain legitimate lexical branches.

surface_mechanism: 96:17 challenges the adversary to call his council or assembly, activating both vocal summons and organized social backing.
96:18 answers with a divine future summons of the zabāniyah, reversing the adversary's call through superior punitive authority.
96:19 rejects obedience to the adversary and replaces it with prostration and approach: refusal, humble worship, embodied lowering, and nearness form one commanded sequence.
The basmala frames divine nearness and punishment under the authority of the merciful Lord without softening the passage's explicit warning.
